Privacy policy

The short version

  • No account, no login, no cookies.
  • No tracking, no advertising, no analytics services.
  • The AI Analyzer and the chat run in your browser. Your answers never leave your device.
  • We never sell data and never pass it on to third parties.

1. Data controller

The persons named in the legal notice above are the controllers under the GDPR. For any privacy question, write to the email address given there.

2. Hosting and server logs

This site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub Inc., USA). When you open it, GitHub stores technically necessary access data including your IP address. We have no influence over this and we do not evaluate that data. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in operating the site securely (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Data transfer to the USA is based on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.

3. Contact form

The contact form sends nothing to a server. It opens your own email program with the message prepared — you decide whether to send it. Only when you send it do we receive your name, email address and message. We use this solely to answer your question (Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR) and delete it once the exchange is finished.

4. Local storage in your browser

We do not set cookies. We only store your language choice and your light/dark setting in your browser's local storage, so the site looks right on your next visit. This information is never transmitted and can be deleted at any time through your browser settings.

5. Your rights

You have the right to information, correction, deletion, restriction of processing, data portability and objection at any time. A short email to us is enough. You may also complain to the data protection authority responsible for your federal state.

The German version is the legally binding one. The other languages are translations provided for easier understanding.
